verdicts.title: Smith Ideals of Operadic Algebras in Monoidal Model Categories
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Building upon Hovey's work on Smith ideals for monoids, we develop a homotopy theory of Smith ideals for general operads in a symmetric monoidal category. verdicts.title: Test ideals via algebras of $p^{-e}$-linear maps
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Continuing ideas of a recent preprint of Schwede arXiv:0906.4313 we study test ideals by viewing them as minimal objects in a certain class of $F$-pure modules over algebras of p^{-e}-linear operators.
